title: Escarpment and Current
author: H. M. Villalobos
blurb: Hazel Delacroix, a salvage diver working a wreck the navy won't discuss, knows the wilderness forgives nothing and forgets less. Then an expedition upriver stops answering the radio — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must outlast the monsoon with a leaking boat and a stranger's help before the concession permits expire.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
